name: Winstonpartwhole Pattern
description: Diagram (this article has no graphical representation)
competency_questions: In what way is one thing part of another - as a component of it, one of its members, a portion of it, the stuff it is made of, a feature of it, or a place within it?; Is a component of a component also a component of the whole thing, and does the same carry over for a member of a member of a collection, a portion of a portion, or the material that a thing's material is made of?; Which larger area is a given thing located in, once you follow the chain of wholes it belongs to?
competency_questions_source: derived from the pattern's own axioms during the OntoBoard review and checked against them; the upstream submission states none
